name: send-only-mac-messages
description: Send direct macOS Messages without exposing local message or contact data.
long_description: A narrow local MCP server with one outbound tool. It accepts an exact phone number and message body, tries iMessage, and retains immediate SMS/RCS fallback. It cannot read conversations, Contacts, chats, attachments, or the Messages database and does not require Full Disk Access.

tools.name: tool_send_message
tools.description: Sends one direct message to an exact phone number through Messages.app. Tries iMessage first and immediately falls back to SMS/RCS when the iMessage AppleScript attempt fails. Returns accepted-unverified or a fixed error code without echoing recipient or message content.
